newsitem.title: GERMANY: Tietmeyer sees no need for rate change - paper.
newsitem.headline: Tietmeyer sees no need for rate change - paper.

text.p: Bundesbank president Hans Tietmeyer was quoted as saying in a newspaper interview that he saw no need for a change in interest rate policy for the time being.
Tietmeyer also said that the current level of interest rates provided the preconditions for an economic upturn.
He told Hamburger Abendblatt in an interview that for the time being he sees "no reason for a change in our interest policy."
The interest rate "preconditions for an economic upturn are clearly given," the paper quoted Tietmeyer as saying.
Tietmeyer also predicted German inflation would remain low in 1997 and said he hoped it would remain "clearly below the two percent level."
The paper released the interview ahead of publication in Tuesday's editions.
